title: Finite compact-support Leray filtration in constructible Weil sheaves
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $h:X_0\to Z_0$ and $g:Z_0\to Y_0$ be separated finite-type morphisms of $k_0$-schemes, with $Z_0,Y_0$ quasi-separated and of finite type over $k_0$. Use constructible $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-Weil sheaves, namely Frobenius-fixed pairs in the constructible heart of the common-stage coefficient category, as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and the compact-support functors of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], with $R^it_!\mathcal F=\mathcal H^i(Rt_!\mathcal F)$ on the geometric fibers, carrying their natural Weil structures. For every constructible Weil sheaf $\mathcal F$ on $X_0$ and every integer $n\geq0$, there is a finite filtration by constructible Weil subsheaves
$$
0=G_0\subseteq G_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq G_m=R^n(gh)_!\mathcal F.
$$
For each $1\leq j\leq m$ there are integers $a_j,b_j\geq0$ with $a_j+b_j=n$, a constructible Weil sheaf $S_j$, a monomorphism
$$S_j\hookrightarrow R^{a_j}g_!\bigl(R^{b_j}h_!\mathcal F\bigr)$$
and an epimorphism
$$S_j\twoheadrightarrow G_j/G_{j-1}.$$
All filtration maps, monomorphisms and epimorphisms are morphisms of Weil sheaves. No mixedness or weight hypothesis is imposed on $\mathcal F$.
